verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official remote MCP server, the Kit MCP, that exposes a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) to MCP-compatible AI clients with read/write access. It turns natural-language prompts into real account actions. A separate official Developer Docs MCP gives coding agents live API reference access, and a probe confirms the MCP docs are published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and documented connection/auth setup details and supported-client specifics.
